set.body: Goal: enforce the graphics family as a self-contained general plotting library and document a credible standalone publication path. Current evidence already satisfied: graphics core imports only scalafim.graphics, the graphics cross-project has no internal dependency, concrete backends depend only on graphics, and domain modules depend inward on the graphics API. Remaining acceptance: add an automated import or build guard; decide whether an initial extraction keeps scalafim.graphics for compatibility or migrates the namespace; document independent versioning and JVM plus Scala.js artifacts with SVG, Canvas, Java2D, and JavaFX as separate backend artifacts; keep README and module-relations synchronized; prove the split remains lift-and-shift rather than a semantic refactor. Actual repository extraction or publication is a separate delivery issue.
set.title: Graphics: prove extraction readiness and document standalone publication
